description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'HomeScreen16454' representing a complex home screen layout. It includes multiple UI components such as cards, statistics, charts, and navigation elements, closely mirroring a Figma design. The file imports various utility and widget components, and defines internal or private widget classes for UI elements like legend rows and bars.
